senses.gloss: f. (Syr. שחתיתא, P. Sm. 4130; cmp. שַׁחַת II) flour of unripe barley mixed with honey; also a drink prepared of flour &c. (cmp. Lat. ptisana).
units: Erub. 29ᵇ ש׳ … תרי וכ׳ for shattitha … take two ladlefuls of roasted barley &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:17">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>שתיתאה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 9, 10); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 151:8">Yalk. Sam. 151</cite> <he>שתיתא</he>.
Snh. 67ᵇ אמר … קריבו ש׳ he said to them, give me a drink of water, and they offered him shattitha; a. e.
